invariants.rationale: The method always returns a reference to a HoodieIndex or throws an exception, so result is never null at exit.
The method only returns objects that are subclasses of HoodieIndex.
Method requires a non-null config to proceed without NPE.
All index constructors appear to pass the provided config, so the index's config field should reference the argument.

meta.value: should hold if HoodieIndex passes config
